cli.help.translate:
Usage: {command} translate status | --mark <page…> | --mark --all | --fix-anchors [page…]

The state of the translations (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.12): status lists, per language, the files current, stale, unmarked and missing; --mark records the source fingerprint of the listed pages (or content paths such as home.md, toc.json) in translations/<lang>/.sources.json; --fix-anchors rewrites #/page~anchor links whose anchor is a heading of the source page, from its position in the translated page.

Options
  --check                  with status: exit code 1 when a file is stale or missing
  --all                    with --mark: every file whose translation exists
  --lang <l>               limits to one language (global option; default: every language but the source)
